mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations ( reservation_id, property_id, user_id, reservation_date, status, created_at ) VALUES ( reservations_seq.NEXTVAL, #{property_id}, #{user_id}, #{reservation_date}, 'PENDING', SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id, r.property_id, r.user_id, r.reservation_date, r.status, r.created_at, p.title AS property_title, u.name AS user_name FROM reservations r JOIN properties p ON r.property_id = p.property_id JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.agent_id = #{agent_id} ORDER BY r.reservation_id DESC
SELECT reservation_date FROM reservations WHERE property_id = #{property_id} AND status != 'CANCELLED'
